note: Photographs #2-4, 12-14, 19, 20 and 24-27 in Dorin's numbered photo labels (Sony A7 III, April-May 2019): the Four Seasons Private Residences at Ten Trinity Square. No residence is identified: no flat or floor numbers, owners or views. The lift-lobby floor indicators and wall signs are blurred.

fs-residences-01.alt: Finished entrance hall in a private residence at Ten Trinity Square: a wall of dark, banded wallcovering with streaks of silver and gold, framed in pale panelling, behind a round mirror and a tan leather bench.

fs-residences-02.alt: The same entrance hall seen along its length: the banded wallcovering runs the full wall under a lit cove ceiling, past the mirror and bench to the front door.

fs-residences-03.alt: Close detail of the entrance-hall wallcovering: soft horizontal bands of charcoal, silver and ochre, laid with no visible seam.

fs-residences-04.alt: Finished dining room in a private residence: a round table and gold armchairs under a cloud of glass discs, with a black sideboard, a round clock and walnut shelving beyond.

fs-residences-05.alt: Finished living room in the same residence: a pale sofa, a blue rug and walnut bookshelves, with a brass-framed screen dividing it from the dining room.

fs-residences-06.alt: Close detail of a woven grasscloth wallcovering turning an external corner, the weave running straight and tight to the edge.

fs-residences-07.alt: A residents’ lift lobby: walls in a warm, banded veneer-effect finish, bronze lift doors and a glazed screen, with the stair rail in the foreground.

fs-residences-08.alt: The banded lobby walls turning a corner towards a pair of glazed doors, with bronze lift doors on the right.

fs-residences-09.alt: A pale lift lobby seen between two stone-effect walls: bronze lift doors either side and a glazed door at the far end.

fs-residences-10.alt: The same lobby from the top of the steps: matched stone-effect walls, bronze lift doors and a glazed door at the end of the corridor.

fs-residences-11.alt: A corner of the lobby: an antiqued mirror panel between two crystal wall lights on the stone-effect walls.

fs-residences-12.alt: The lobby beside the stair: stone-effect walls, a bronze lift door, a ventilation grille and the antiqued mirror beyond.
